prompt.description: Prompt to pass to Codex. `prompt` or `prompt-file` must be provided.

prompt-file.description: Path to file that contains the prompt to pass to Codex. `prompt` or `prompt-file` must be provided.

output-file.description: File where the final Codex message is written. Leave empty to skip writing a file.

openai-api-key.description: OpenAI API key used by Codex.

responses-api-endpoint.description: Optional Responses API endpoint override, e.g. https://example.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/responses. Defaults to the proxy's built-in endpoint when empty.

working-directory.description: Working directory that Codex should use. Defaults to the repository root.

sandbox.description:

output-schema.description: Inline schema contents to use with `codex exec --output-schema`.

output-schema-file.description: File path to the schema that should be passed to `codex exec --output-schema`.

effort.description: Reasoning effort the agent should use.

codex-home.description: Trusted Codex home/config directory. If empty, the default Codex home directory will be used.
